content.scope: execution resilience only; unchanged data, folds, prompts, model, scores, selection and holdout rules
content.evidence: docs/diagnostico-http400.json: a single manually diagnosed identical request changed from pre-inference HTTP400 invalid_prompt to HTTP200 with valid probabilities
content.rule: one retry per exact request hash, only for confirmed unbilled HTTP400 invalid_prompt invalid_request_error; maximum 20 such recoveries per phase; existing conservative reservation before any new call
exclusions: no retry with uncertain pending charges
no completion or guessing of missing predictions
no dropping of failed query rows
content.format_recovery: unique complete archived JSON extraction, no new inference for recovered batch; maximum 10 per phase
content.no_automatic_retry_rule: this explicit operational amendment supersedes the original no-retry rule only for the documented unbilled transient rejection; all other failures still stop
